name: 177-cross-repo-session-root
note: #177: args.sessionRoot is the root of a session opened in another repository than the run worktree (agents would receive that session's instruction files): the session-root probe answers SESSION-ROOT:differs and the run stops on escalate (reason session-root-mismatch) before provisioning, any label write and any agent call beyond the probe. On the base engine (no sessionRoot gate) the run never asks this probe and does not escalate for this reason.

args.brief: a run driven from a session opened in another repository must be refused, not run under the wrong instructions
